title: ヴィクトリアマイルにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've cleared away all my doubts! I'm going to make Sweep eat my dust! …In the most sportsmanlike way possible, of course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even the paddock can't contain me today—I'll dash out and make a declaration to all of my fans! I'm going to shine ever brighter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I hope all my opponent princesses are ready! Can you handle my Princess☆Suplex?!
